items.title: Macaulay Culkin's Emmys tribute to Catherine O'Hara
items.summary: At the Emmys, Catherine O'Hara's on-screen children Macaulay Culkin, Annie Murphy and Dan Levy paid tribute to her. Culkin's line "She may have forgotten me twice… but we will always remember her" was the most-liked moment of the night, with 157K likes on Film Updates' post. A clip of Martin Short and Steve Martin crying in the audience also spread.
items.author: @FilmUpdates

post.name: Film Updates
post.text:
Macaulay Culkin honors the late Catherine O’Hara at the Emmy Awards:

“She may have forgotten me twice… but we will always remember her.”
